title: iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS 27
summary: Apple released major annual software updates including iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS 27, bringing new features and improvements across their entire device ecosystem including iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
problem_solved: Provides users with updated operating systems featuring new capabilities, improved performance, enhanced privacy features, and better cross-device integration.
why_valuable: These platform updates affect billions of devices and shape the daily experience of Apple users worldwide, making them among the most impactful software releases each year.
